high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "scienceoftheuniverse." The post features a photo with three individuals standing in front of a large, metallic, circular object that resembles a portal or time machine. The setting appears to be outdoors, with trees and grass visible in the background, suggesting a natural environment. The individuals are dressed in different styles: The person on the left is wearing a brown leather jacket over a plaid shirt and dark pants. The person in the middle is dressed in a formal suit.
